+import pytest
+import structlog
+from structlog import contextvars, threadlocal
+from structlog.testing import ReturnLogger
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.filterwarnings("ignore::DeprecationWarning")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def clean_contexts():
+    contextvars.clear_contextvars()
+    threadlocal.clear_threadlocal()
+    yield
+    contextvars.clear_contextvars()
+    threadlocal.clear_threadlocal()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", [contextvars, threadlocal])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("overwrite", [None, False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ambient", [1, None])
+def test_processor_policy(api, overwrite, ambient):
+    suffix = "contextvars" if api is contextvars else "threadlocal"
+    getattr(api, f"bind_{suffix}")(shared=ambient, only_local=2)
+    event = {"shared": "call", "only_event": 3}
+    kwargs = {} if overwrite is None else {"overwrite": overwrite}
+    result = getattr(api, f"merge_{suffix}")(None, "info", event, **kwargs)
+    expected = ambient if overwrite else "call"
+    assert result == {"shared": expected, "only_local": 2, "only_event": 3}
+    assert (result is event) is (api is contextvars)
+    if api is threadlocal:
+        assert event == {"shared": "call", "only_event": 3}
+    assert getattr(api, f"get_{suffix}")() == {"shared": ambient, "only_local": 2}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", [contextvars, threadlocal])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("overwrite", [None, False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ambient", [1, None])
+def test_retrieval_policy(api, overwrite, ambient):
+    suffix = "contextvars" if api is contextvars else "threadlocal"
+    getattr(api, f"bind_{suffix}")(shared=ambient, only_local=2)
+    log = structlog.wrap_logger(ReturnLogger(), processors=[]).bind(
+        shared="bound", only_bound=3
+    )
+    kwargs = {} if overwrite is None else {"overwrite": overwrite}
+    result = getattr(api, f"get_merged_{suffix}")(log, **kwargs)
+    expected = ambient if overwrite else "bound"
+    assert result == {"shared": expected, "only_local": 2, "only_bound": 3}
+    assert structlog.get_context(log) == {"shared": "bound", "only_bound": 3}
